title: Skills
desc: Skills teach the worker new abilities — a set of instructions it follows when the skill applies.
writeMyselfDesc: A name, a description, and the instructions
importFileDesc: A .zip or SKILL.md someone shared — you review before it installs
createWithAgentDesc: Describe what you want and the worker writes the skill for you
reviewWarning: Read the instructions — installing a skill means the worker will follow them
descPlaceholder: One line the worker uses to decide when this applies
emptyState: No skills yet — add one above to teach the worker new tricks
